comment:
No actionable defect found in the inspected change at `ef16ffa4c611`.

**Verified from source:** after a valid version-1 user configuration has loaded, empty or invalid reloads leave the current configuration intact. Subsequent shell-side mutations therefore use that retained configuration rather than the defaults. A later valid configuration is still accepted.

| Reload input | Baseline | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Empty/invalid, before any valid user load | Defaults | Defaults |
| Empty/invalid, after a valid user load | Defaults | Retain current configuration |
| Valid version-1 object | Apply user configuration | Apply user configuration |

**Scope limits:** retention is in memory, not an on-disk backup. Restarting while the file remains empty still takes the first-load defaults path. Separate disk-based writers, such as `omarchy bar position`, still start from defaults when the file is empty; that pre-existing path is unchanged.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source inspection of the configuration reload/mutation paths and the added source-pattern test. No tests or Quickshell/FileView runtime behavior were executed; the original truncation was not reproduced.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, then Astra Medium synthesis checked against the pinned source.
